requirements.requirement: The system must generate a valid state_board_url for a provider when a supported state code (e.g., DE, MS, VA) is present.
The system must return a null or empty state_board_url when the provider state is missing or unsupported.
The system must include the generated state_board_url in the evidence_links field of the malpractice object.
The system must detect a negative malpractice indicator when NPI status is deactivated or flagged as inactive.
The system must set npdb_flag to true when a proxy indicator for sanctions or disciplinary action is present in the input data.
The system must set npdb_flag to unknown when no proxy indicator data is available.
The system must compute action_count as the total number of detected negative indicators from all available sources.
The system must assign a severity_score that decreases as action_count increases.
The system must not increase or positively adjust severity_score when no negative indicators are present.
The system must return a neutral severity_score when action_count equals zero.
The system must construct and return a malpractice object conforming to the schema defined in EVAL-P-MALPRACTICE-SCHEMA-001.
The system must handle missing provider input data without throwing runtime errors and still return a valid malpractice object with unknown fields.
The system must ensure that evidence_links contains only valid URL strings or is empty when no links can be generated.
The system must not fabricate or infer specific malpractice actions when no verified or proxy indicators are present.
